```{r TSS}

# plots --------------------------------------------------------------

# Create data frame with the distances and counts
distances <- c(1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000, 8000, 9000, 10000, 12000, 15000)

# Read counts from the files
counts <- c(167, 188, 203, 222, 232, 252, 274, 295, 305, 325, 359, 405)

# Create data frame
data <- data.frame(distance = distances, count = counts)

# Plot
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data, aes(x = distance, y = count)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = distances, labels = distances) +
    labs(x = "Buffer Distance (bp)", y = "Number of Overlaps", 
         title = "Effect of TSS Buffer Distance on Number of Overlaps") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Save the plot
#ggsave("../peak_comparisons/TSS_distance_plot.png", width = 10, height = 6)
```

```{r genes}
### PEAKYS ###
peaky_M_TSS <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/peak_comparisons/merged_peaky_M_5000_fulltable_TSS_10kbp.bed")

peaky_P_TSS <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/peak_comparisons/merged_peaky_P_5000_fulltable_TSS_10kbp.bed")

# keep only the unique gene nominations

unique_peaky_M_TSS <- distinct(peaky_M_TSS, V14, .keep_all = TRUE)
unique_peaky_P_TSS <- distinct(peaky_P_TSS, V14, .keep_all = TRUE)

# peaky and chicane uses very different scores. Rank them, then normalise to 0-1, then 1- that.
# following the formula of 1- (x-min)/(max-min)

min_max_rank_normalize <- function(x) {
    ranked <- rank(x)
    normalized <- (ranked - min(ranked)) / (max(ranked) - min(ranked))
    return(normalized)
}

unique_peaky_M_TSS$normalised_peak_score <- 1-(min_max_rank_normalize(unique_peaky_M_TSS$V4)) # the smaller, the better

unique_peaky_P_TSS$normalised_peak_score <-  1-(min_max_rank_normalize(unique_peaky_P_TSS$V4)) # the smaller, the better


### CHICANES ###

chicane_M_TSS <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/peak_comparisons/merged_chicane_M_5000_fulltable_TSS_10kbp.bed")

chicane_P_TSS <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/peak_comparisons/merged_chicane_P_5000_fulltable_TSS_10kbp.bed")

# keep only the unique gene nominations

unique_chicane_M_TSS <- distinct(chicane_M_TSS, V14, .keep_all = TRUE)
unique_chicane_P_TSS <- distinct(chicane_P_TSS, V14, .keep_all = TRUE)

# peaky and chicane uses very different scores. Normalise to 0-1
# following the formula of (x-min)/(max-min)

unique_chicane_M_TSS$normalised_peak_score <- min_max_rank_normalize(unique_chicane_M_TSS$V4)
unique_chicane_P_TSS$normalised_peak_score <- min_max_rank_normalize(unique_chicane_P_TSS$V4)


# how many are shared between m and p?

table(unique_chicane_M_TSS$V14 %in% unique_chicane_P_TSS$V14)
table(unique_peaky_M_TSS$V14 %in% unique_peaky_P_TSS$V14)

# which ones are not shared?
unique_peaky_M_TSS[!which(unique_peaky_M_TSS$V14 %in% unique_peaky_P_TSS$V14)]

### combine the all, have a column indicating origin and maturity

TSS_combination <- bind_rows(list(peaky_M = unique_peaky_M_TSS, peaky_P = unique_peaky_P_TSS, chicane_M = unique_chicane_M_TSS, chicane_P = unique_chicane_P_TSS), .id = "origin") %>% 
    dplyr::rename(target_chr = V1, target_start = V2, target_stop = V3, mean_peak_score = V4, count = V5, multiviewpoint = V6, bait_chr = V7, bait_start = V8, bait_stop = V9, awk_score = V10, TSS_chr = V11, TSS_start = V12, TSS_stop = V13, gene_nominated = V14) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-V15)


TSS_combination$which_peak_caller <- ifelse(str_detect(TSS_combination$origin, "peaky"), yes = "peaky", no = "chicane")
TSS_combination$which_cell_state <- ifelse(str_detect(TSS_combination$origin, "_P"), yes = "pre", no = "mature")

TSS_processed <- TSS_combination %>% 
    group_by(gene_nominated) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(nominated_by = paste(unique(origin), collapse = "; ")) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    distinct(gene_nominated, .keep_all = T)


final_gene_list <- TSS_combination %>%  distinct(., gene_nominated) # 545 unique genes across m, p, peaky & chicane

#write_csv(final_gene_list, "czjs_final_tci_list.txt")
### harmonise gene names...

# Map TSS genes to official symbols and ENSG IDs...
TSS_mapped_symbol <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = TSS_combination$gene_nominated, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ALIAS", multiVals = "first")
TSS_mapped_ENSG <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = TSS_combination$gene_nominated, column = "ENSEMBL", keytype = "ALIAS", multiVals = "first")


# Check their NA content...

table(is.na(TSS_mapped_symbol))
table(is.na(TSS_mapped_ENSG))

TSS_mapped_symbol[which(is.na(TSS_mapped_symbol))]

TSS_mapped_ENSG[which(is.na(TSS_mapped_ENSG))]

#write_tsv(TSS_processed, "raw_count_data_per_gene.tsv")


```


```{r eQTL}

# the eQTL files are massive so instead of loading them into R, process in the command line
# wrangle so the first 3 columns are the baits, bc we want to know if the eQTLs at the bait predict the genes overlapped
eQTL_unique_genes <- TSS_processed %>% 
    relocate(c(bait_chr, bait_start, bait_stop), .before = origin)

#write_tsv(as.data.frame(eQTL_unique_genes), "../peak_comparisons/all_called_unique_genes.bed", col_names = F)

# bedtools intersect -wo -a ../capoverlaps/Adipose_Subcutaneous_snps_lifted.bed -b all_called_unique_genes.bed > Adipose_Subcutaneous_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed
# 
# bedtools intersect -wo -a ../capoverlaps/AdipoExpress_snps_lifted.bed -b all_called_unique_genes.bed > AdipoExpress_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed
# 
# bedtools intersect -wo -a ../capoverlaps/FUSION_ge_adipose_naive_snps_lifted.bed -b all_called_unique_genes.bed > FUSION_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed
# 
# bedtools intersect -wo -a ../capoverlaps/TwinsUK_ge_fat_snps_lifted.bed -b all_called_unique_genes.bed > TwinsUK_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed


TwinsUK <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/peak_comparisons/TwinsUK_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed")
FUSION <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/peak_comparisons/FUSION_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed")
# AdipoExpress <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/capoverlaps/AdipoExpress_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed") # has too many unuseable gene IDs, have to ask genetics ppl like GATL when he's back
Adipose_Subcutaneous <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/peak_comparisons/Adipose_Subcutaneous_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed")

# merge/collapse/unique

all_eQTLs <- bind_rows(TwinsUK, FUSION, Adipose_Subcutaneous, .id = "origin") # excluded AdipoExpress for now

has_eQTLs <- all_eQTLs %>% 
    dplyr::select( eQTL_gene = V4,caller_nominated = V19)


#################  MAINTAIN GENE SYMBOLS AND ENSG IDS SEPERATELY, MERGE BY ENSG ID

# Combine all possible keys into one list
all_keys <- unique(c(has_eQTLs$eQTL_gene, has_eQTLs$caller_nominated))


# Map all keys to official gene symbols, using ENSEMBL as fallback
mapped_genes_ensembl <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                               keys = all_keys, 
                               column = "ENSEMBL", 
                               keytype = "ALIAS", 
                               multiVals = "first")

# Replace NA with all_keys entries only if they are ENSG IDs
mapped_genes <- ifelse(
    !is.na(mapped_genes_ensembl), 
    mapped_genes_ensembl, 
    ifelse(grepl("^ENSG", all_keys), all_keys, NA)
)

# Convert to a data frame for easier merging
mapped_genes_table <- data.frame(
    original_name = names(mapped_genes),
    unified_symbol = mapped_genes,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# Most NAs are for Pseudogenes or for Non-coding genes... 

# Merge back with the original data
eQTLs_genes_unified <- has_eQTLs %>%
    left_join(mapped_genes_table, by = c("eQTL_gene" = "original_name")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(unified_eQTL_name = unified_symbol) %>%
    left_join(mapped_genes_table, by = c("caller_nominated" = "original_name")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(unified_caller_name = unified_symbol)

# Replace `unified_caller_name` with ENSG ID if no match is found
eQTLs_genes_unified <- eQTLs_genes_unified %>%
    mutate(unified_caller_name = ifelse(is.na(unified_caller_name),
                                        caller_nominated,  # Replace with ENSG ID
                                        unified_caller_name))

# Most reduced dataset possible
eQTLs_genes_unified <- eQTLs_genes_unified %>%
    mutate(is_nominated_by_eqtl = ifelse(unified_eQTL_name == unified_caller_name, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
    distinct(unified_caller_name, .keep_all = T) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-caller_nominated, -eQTL_gene, -unified_eQTL_name) %>% 
    replace_na(list(is_nominated_by_eqtl = FALSE))



```


```{r expression}

# DAAP6 expression --------------------------------------------------------

DAAP6_expression <- fread("DAAP6_RNAseq_results_APs_v_mADs.csv")

### careful, need to unify the genes again

# Use unique_genes as the primary source of gene names
all_genes <- unique(c(TSS_processed$gene_nominated, DAAP6_expression$symbol))

# Map genes to official symbols using ENSEMBL
mapped_genes_ensembl <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                               keys = all_genes, 
                               column = "ENSEMBL", 
                               keytype = "ALIAS", 
                               multiVals = "first")


# Replace NA with all_genes entries only if they are ENSG IDs
mapped_genes <- ifelse(
    !is.na(mapped_genes_ensembl), 
    mapped_genes_ensembl, 
    ifelse(grepl("^ENSG", all_genes), all_genes, NA)
)

mapped_genes <- unlist(mapped_genes)

# Convert to a data frame for easier merging
mapped_genes_table <- data.frame(
    original_name = names(mapped_genes),
    unified_ensembl_id = mapped_genes,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# Unify TSS_processed genes
TSS_genes_unified <- TSS_processed %>%
    left_join(mapped_genes_table, by = c("gene_nominated" = "original_name")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(TSS_ensembl = unified_ensembl_id) 

# Unify DAAP6_expression
DAAP6_genes_unified <- DAAP6_expression %>%
    left_join(mapped_genes_table, by = c("symbol" = "original_name")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(DAAP6_ensembl = unified_ensembl_id) 



### Merge datasets

TSS_expression <- left_join(TSS_genes_unified, DAAP6_genes_unified, by = c("TSS_ensembl" = "DAAP6_ensembl"), na_matches = "never", keep = TRUE)

### there are some strange cases of "unified" gene names that aren't correct
# remove these for now and come back to them

TSS_expression_reduced <- TSS_expression[duplicated(TSS_expression$TSS_ensembl),]



TSS_expression_duplicates <- TSS_expression[duplicated(TSS_expression$TSS_ensembl) | duplicated(TSS_expression$TSS_ensembl, fromLast = T) ,]
TSS_expression_uniques <- TSS_expression[!(duplicated(TSS_expression$TSS_ensembl) | duplicated(TSS_expression$TSS_ensembl, fromLast = T)) ,]

#write_csv(TSS_expression_duplicates, "../peak_comparisons/TSS_expression_duplicates.csv")

expression_n_eqtls <- left_join(TSS_expression_uniques, eQTLs_genes_unified, by = c("TSS_ensembl" = "unified_caller_name"))


expression_n_eqtls_procd <- expression_n_eqtls %>% 
    mutate(has_differential_exp_data = ifelse(TSS_ensembl == DAAP6_ensembl, TRUE, FALSE),
           gene_description = description,
           DAPP6_log2foldchange = log2FoldChange,
           DAAP6_padj = padj,
           DAAP6_direction = direction,
           DAAP6_unified_gene = symbol,
           pass_standard_threshold_diff = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1 & padj < 0.05 ,TRUE, FALSE),
           pass_stringent_threshold_diff = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1.6 & padj < 0.01,TRUE, FALSE),
           distance_of_gene_from_TSS = abs((round((expression_n_eqtls$bait_stop-expression_n_eqtls$bait_start)/2)+expression_n_eqtls$bait_start) - expression_n_eqtls$TSS_start),
           pass_distance_threshold = ifelse(distance_of_gene_from_TSS > 10000, TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-(starts_with("V")), -symbol, -biotype, -description, -log2FoldChange, -padj, -direction, -DAAP6_ensembl, -origin, -(starts_with("target")), -(starts_with("bait")), -TSS_chr, -TSS_start, -TSS_stop,-awk_score, -which_peak_caller, -which_cell_state) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    mutate(DAAP6_padj_005 = DAAP6_padj <0.05,
           DAAP6_padj_001 = DAAP6_padj <0.01, 
           DAAP6_log_1 = DAPP6_log2foldchange < -1 | DAPP6_log2foldchange > 1,
           DAAP6_log_16 = DAPP6_log2foldchange < -1.6 | DAPP6_log2foldchange > 1.6) %>% relocate(TSS_ensembl)


```

```{r enrichment}

####    NOT ADJUSTED TO USING ENSG IDS YET!!!! ####
# enrichment --------------------------------------------------------

# are the nominated genes more expressed/more anything than the non-nominated ones? 


all_genes_in_1mbp <- fread("../peak_comparisons/gene_tss_in_1mbp.bed")

# unify

# Use unique_genes as the primary source of gene names
all_genes <- unique(c(expressions_6n8_eqtls_final$TSS_ensembl, all_genes_in_1mbp$V8))

# Map genes to official symbols using ALIAS
mapped_genes_alias <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                             keys = all_genes, 
                             column = "SYMBOL", 
                             keytype = "ALIAS", 
                             multiVals = "first")

# Map genes to official symbols using ENSEMBL as fallback
mapped_genes_ensembl <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                               keys = all_genes, 
                               column = "SYMBOL", 
                               keytype = "ENSEMBL", 
                               multiVals = "first")


# Combine mappings, prioritizing ALIAS over ENSEMBL
mapped_genes <- ifelse(!is.na(mapped_genes_alias), mapped_genes_alias, mapped_genes_ensembl)

mapped_genes <- unlist(mapped_genes)


# Convert to a data frame for easier merging
mapped_genes_table <- data.frame(
    original_name = names(mapped_genes),
    unified_gene_symbol = mapped_genes,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# Furthermore, if there is no common symbol for the ENSEMBL id, then replace it with the ENSEMBL ID

mapped_genes_table_final <- mapped_genes_table %>%
    mutate(final_gene_symbol = coalesce(unified_gene_symbol, original_name))


# Unify 1mbp genes
one_mbp_genes_unified <- all_genes_in_1mbp %>%
    left_join(mapped_genes_table_final, by = c("V8" = "original_name")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(unified_one_mbp_gene_name = final_gene_symbol) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-unified_gene_symbol)

not_nominated <- one_mbp_genes_unified[!one_mbp_genes_unified$unified_one_mbp_gene_name %in% expressions_6n8_eqtls_final$TSS_ensembl]
```

``` {r not_nominated_eqtls}


all_eqtls_unique <- unique(all_eQTLs$V4)
all_peaks_unique <- unique(one_mbp_genes_unified$V8)

# Add a column to indicate whether a gene is peak-nominated
all_peaks_status <- data.frame(
    gene = all_peaks_unique,
    is_peak_nominated = all_peaks_unique %in% expressions_6n8_eqtls_final$TSS_ensembl
)

# Create a data frame for eQTL genes
all_eqtls_status <- data.frame(
    gene = all_eqtls_unique,
    is_eqtl = TRUE
)

# Merge eQTL data with peak-nominated status
merged_status <- merge(all_eqtls_status, all_peaks_status, by = "gene", all = TRUE)

# Replace NA values with FALSE
merged_status <- merged_status %>%
    mutate(
        is_eqtl = ifelse(is.na(is_eqtl), FALSE, is_eqtl),
        is_peak_nominated = ifelse(is.na(is_peak_nominated), FALSE, is_peak_nominated)
    )

# Create a contingency table
contingency_table <- table(merged_status$is_eqtl, merged_status$is_peak_nominated)

# View the contingency table
print(contingency_table)

# Perform Fisher's exact test
fisher_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
print(fisher_result)

# Summarize proportions
proportions <- merged_status %>%
    group_by(is_peak_nominated) %>%
    summarize(proportion_eqtl = mean(is_eqtl))

# Plot proportions
ggplot(proportions, aes(x = is_peak_nominated, y = proportion_eqtl, fill = is_peak_nominated)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +
    labs(title = "Proportion of eQTLs in Peak-Nominated vs Non-Peak-Nominated Genes",
         x = "Peak-Nominated",
         y = "Proportion with eQTLs") +
    theme_minimal()
```

``` {r druggable}
ggplot(df_long_drugs, aes(x = value, y = n, fill = value)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5) +  # Add count labels
    labs(title = "Counts of TRUE and FALSE for various druggabilities", x = "Value", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plots <- lapply(split(df_long_drugs, df_long_drugs$variable), function(subdf) {
    ggplot(subdf, aes(x = value, y = n, fill = value)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
        geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5) +
        labs(title = unique(subdf$variable), x = "Value", y = "Count") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
})

# To display all plots (in RStudio or Jupyter, for example)
library(patchwork)
wrap_plots(plots) # has conflicts with other packages...
```

``` {r gsea}
)
```

``` {r heatmapmadness}
qux <- left_join(TSS_combination, minimal_master_key, join_by("bait_chr"=="V1", "bait_start"=="V2", "bait_stop"=="V3"))

# genes with a direct match

final_140_list$gene_nominated %in% TSS_combination$gene_nominated

table(TSS_combination$gene_nominated %in% final_140_list$gene_nominated)

genes_with_bait_annotation <- final_140_list[final_140_list$gene_nominated %in% TSS_combination$gene_nominated
]

tss_with_annotation <- TSS_combination[TSS_combination$gene_nominated %in% final_140_list$gene_nominated] # 231

hmm <- unique(tss_with_annotation, by =c("gene_nominated", "bait_start"))

foo <- left_join(genes_with_bait_annotation, qux, by = "gene_nominated") %>%  #also 231
    distinct(gene_nominated, gwas, .keep_all = T)

# genes without a direct match

!final_140_list$gene_nominated %in% TSS_combination$gene_nominated

genes_without_bait_annotation <- final_140_list[!final_140_list$gene_nominated %in% TSS_combination$gene_nominated]


bleh <-  left_join(genes_without_bait_annotation, qux, join_by("DAAP6_unified_gene"=="gene_nominated")) %>% #2 rows
    distinct(gene_nominated, gwas, .keep_all = T) # 1 row


tadah <- bind_rows(foo, bleh) %>% 
    mutate(nominated_by_T2D = ifelse(str_detect(gwas, "T2D"), yes = "1", no = "0" ),
           nominated_by_whr = ifelse(str_detect(gwas, "whr"), yes = "1", no = "0" ),
           viewpoint_overlaps_H3K27ac_ATAC = "1",
           nominated_by_capture_c = "1") %>% 
    dplyr::select(nominated_by_T2D, nominated_by_whr, viewpoint_overlaps_H3K27ac_ATAC, is_nominated_by_eqtl, multiviewpoint = multiviewpoint.x, nominated_by_capture_c, has_ee_data, has_differential_exp_data, gene_nominated)



heatmap_data <- tadah %>% #final_70_list_drugs #genes_with_drugs
    dplyr::select(-gene_nominated) %>% 
    mutate_all(as.numeric)

# replace all NAs with binary FALSE = 0
heatmap_data[is.na(heatmap_data)] <- 0

# Convert to a matrix
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(heatmap_data)

rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- tadah$gene_nominated

library(viridis)

# Plot the heatmap
pheatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,  # Cluster rows
    cluster_cols = FALSE,  # Cluster columns
    main = "Annotations for final 140 genes",
    angle_col = "45",
    legend_labels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"), legend = T, legend_breaks = c(0,1), 
    color = mako(n = 2,  begin = 1, end = 0.7),
    border_color = FALSE,
    gaps_col = c(4,4,4, 6,6,6),
    show_rownames = T,
    labels_col = c("Region nominated by T2D GWAS", "Region nominated by WHR GWAS", "Region overlaps ATAC+H3K27ac", "Gene nominated by eQTL", "Gene nominated by multiple capture viewpoints", "Gene nominated by Capture C", "Has energy expenditure expression data", "Has differentiation expression data")
    
)

pheatmap(
    t(heatmap_matrix),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,  # Cluster rows
    cluster_cols = TRUE,  # Cluster columns
    main = "Annotations for final 140 genes",
    angle_col = "45",
    legend_labels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"), legend = T, legend_breaks = c(0,1), 
    color = mako(n = 2,  begin = 1, end = 0.7),
    border_color = FALSE,
    gaps_row = c(4,4,4, 6,6,6),
    show_rownames = T, fontsize_row = 5, fontsize_col = 5
)
```
